jobgether-jobgether:lever:3b436d45-6186-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Working at the intersection of supply chain, construction, engineering, logistics, and suppliers, you will turn equipment schedules into actionable delivery plans. Serve as the primary escalation point for factory delays, component shortages, testing failures, shipping issues, and other delivery risks, developing recovery plans such as expediting, partial shipments, resequencing, or alternate sourcing. Coordinate transportation for oversized, overweight, high-value equipment, including carrier selection, route surveys, permits, crane and rigging requirements, and related logistics activities. Manage laydown, staging, and interim storage decisions when equipment arrives before or after site readiness, coordinating receiving inspections and preservation requirements with quality and commissioning teams. Identify, prioritize, and communicate delivery risks across multiple projects, recommending actions and driving decisions that protect capacity and ready-for-service milestones. Establish recurring delivery reviews and reporting for leadership, covering equipment status, supplier performance, schedule risk, and portfolio-level constraints. Track key delivery metrics such as on-time-to-required-on-site performance, schedule drift, escalation cycle time, and expedite costs, using data to identify systemic issues and improve future programs. Capture lessons learned and provide feedback to sourcing and construction teams to improve lead-time assumptions, delivery terms, buffer strategies, and equipment sequencing. rws-rws:lever:eb830e79-65aa-4025-8427-bb.title: Social Media Content Evaluator (Italian)
rws-rws:lever:eb830e79-65aa-4025-8427-bb.description: About the Role In this role, you will play a critical part in shaping the future of artificial intelligence and media analysis. Your main responsibility will be to review short-form video media and classify the language present in both spoken audio and on-screen text. By validating content within your native locale, you will generate high-quality "ground truth" data. Job Type: Freelance Location: Italy (work from home) Work Schedule: Part-time — 4 hours per day required. (Flexible schedule: you can choose your hours as long as the daily time requirement is met). Work whenever you want. Start Date: Immediately Duration: TBC Rate: 11 USD per hour What You’ll Do Media Evaluation: Watch and analyze short-form video clips to identify all languages present in the audio and on-screen text. Locale Validation: Verify and validate that the media content aligns with your specific target locale (e.g., verifying that the media content uses authentic target language and aligns with the cultural context of that language). Data Labeling: Generate highly accurate ground truth labels using our internal classification tools according to strict project guidelines. Quality Assurance: Ensure high data quality and consistency to meet the standards required for training automated machine learning models. What we’re looking for: Must be currently living in Italy. Native-level written and spoken fluency in Italian. Access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a secure personal computer/laptop. Ability to strictly follow detailed photography and data entry guidelines. (Preferred but not required) Previous experience in data annotation, content moderation, translation, transcription, or linguistic QA is a strong asset.

southparkcommons-render:ashbyhq:b7508c39.title: Staff Product Manager, CI/CD & Developer Productivity
southparkcommons-render:ashbyhq:b7508c39.description: At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure. Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users. Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. APPLYING TO RENDER We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. ABOUT THE ROLE You'll own the path from commit to running production software on Render: the build system, the deploy experience, and the primitives that make delivery composable, including reusable build artifacts, multi-service deployment, deployment pipelines, and infrastructure as code. In practice, you own the part of our customers' SDLC that Render is responsible for, and the developer productivity outcomes that come with it. This is a high-leverage area. The simplicity of the build and deploy experience is one of the main reasons developers choose Render, and it's also where our fastest-growing customers feel the most pain as they scale. Slow builds, redundant rebuilds, and hard-to-diagnose failures show up directly in developer engagement and in retention. The loop is also changing shape: more of the code arriving on Render isn't written by a human, which changes what a deploy is, who is waiting on it, and what has to be true before it goes out. You'll work with a dedicated engineering team and partner closely with infrastructure, design, customer success, and go-to-market. Your customers span the full spectrum: solo developers deploying their first service, fast-growing startups shipping daily, and platform teams running hundreds of services across growing engineering orgs. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Shape build and deploy experiences that feel simple from hundred-line prototypes to architectures with hundreds of services, and work seamlessly whether the thing shipping code is a person or an AI agent. - Own the build and deploy system end to end. Set the roadmap and own the outcomes: build and deploy speed, deploy success rate, and time to diagnose a failure. - Define and ship foundational primitives such as reusable build artifacts and application-level deployment, rat

ullico-ullico:lever:0a0cff4c-4da4-4847-8.title: Assistant Mortgage Servicer
ullico-ullico:lever:0a0cff4c-4da4-4847-8.description: Ullico, Inc., one of the nation’s largest sources for real estate first mortgage financing, is actively recruiting an Assistant Mortgage Servicer to join a group that manages a $4.4 billion portfolio. Ullico’s Real Estate Debt Group offers construction and permanent debt financing for commercial real estate. This position is located at our Bethesda, MD office.
responsibilities: Enter data relative to new loans into computer system. Check entry for accuracy and completeness.
Obtain all related source documents from Treasury and other contributing parties.   Process daily transactions to the loan system. Research and resolve missing payments. Monitor all payment activity.
Obtain daily SOFR rates from Global Benchmark Administrator and the Wall Street Journal and input into the LMS Loan Servicing System. Follow up for second check sign off.
Generate Accrual General Ledger Entries for the REIG Department (Delinquent and Pre-Paid loans).
Input Deposits (checks and incoming wires) into the on-line Deposit System ensuring the correct cash account is used.
Post general Ledger Entries for Separate J, Separate W and General Accounts.
Track incoming funds to ensure that all funds intended for the Escrow Account are promptly transferred.

Utilizing an Excel spreadsheet(s), balance required GL accounts daily to the Company Ledger. Ensure zero balances in cash accounts at month-end. Research and resolve issues related to unbalanced accounts. Ensure that month-end processing is completed accurately and on time.
Facilitate loans, obtain information, respond to routine inquires, and resolve long-standing or complex problems by interfacing with outside vendors and representatives.
Establish, maintain, and monitor various tickler systems for servicing functions. Obtain information and resolve issues by contacting borrowers and I or third parties.
Coordinate and process wires for timely payment to investors and internal balancing of accounts. Request checks to pay third party invoices.
Design and distribute scheduled and unique reports and excel spreadsheets.
File documents and maintain servicing related binders.
Perform other job-related duties that may be occasionally assigned.
qualifications: Associate’s degree in accounting or equivalent training and/or experience.
Two years of accounting experience required with a demonstrated knowledge and application of debits, credits, assets, liabilities, income and expense functions.
Two years’ experience with real estate operations or loan servicing preferred.
Demonstrated knowledge of PC in Windows environment with word processing and spreadsheet software required.
Must take company excel test at an intermediate level.
Familiarity with terminology and I or forms of functional area preferred.
Demonstrated written and oral communication skills.

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:4a16e3ab-22d.description: About Welocalize Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale. Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com About the role- We are looking for individuals with BSL (British Sign Language) and strong technical video knowledge with a background and work experience in video editing to join our We localize team in UK. Job Details: Location: UK Type of employment: Contract Project duration: 12 Months with Possible extension Working schedule: 08:30-17:00 or 09:00-17:30 UK Standard Time with 30 minutes unpaid lunch break (40 hours/ week) * Tuesday to Saturday or Sunday to Thursday shift Yearly Salary: £31,850/year Successful candidates must have valid work authorization for the UK with no need for sponsorship Key Qualifications: British Sign Language (this is a must) Passion for digital video and knowledge of the film and TV industry Possess a thorough working knowledge of common technical issues found in digital video and audio Willingness to work in a high-volume, fast paced, and changing environment 2-4 years of experience working with digital video Ability to take initiative and troubleshoot video/system playback issues and identify trends to propose short and long-term solutions Track record of responding quickly and decisively to issues Effective verbal and written communication skills The ideal candidate should have experience with all of the following: Knowledge of subscription video content services and familiarity of their product offerings Intermediate to advanced spreadsheet knowledge. Professional/advanced proficiency in any other language would be a big plus. (optional but valuable)
